candidates.description: This vector represents political, ideological, and socio-economic suffixes and root words, particularly pertaining to various "-isms" and their adherents.
This vector represents abstract ideas, conceptual frameworks, and their linguistic expressions.
These tokens represent common French adverbs and adverbial modifiers used to express frequency, consequence, or emphasis.
These tokens represent common given names of Germanic and European origin.
This vector activates on words, prefixes, and roots containing the character sequence "prop" or associated with property and capitalism.
This vector activates for British English spelling variants and morphology, particularly words ending in '-ise', '-isation', and '-gramme'.
This feature activates for word endings and suffixes containing nasal and dental consonants.
This feature vector activates on concepts related to disagreement, contradiction, and logical opposition.
Common prefixes and combining forms used in word formation.
This vector represents subword fragments and morphological roots shared across multiple European languages.
